comment: Methylates C-3 of 2-oxoglutarate (α-ketoglutarate); the product is transaminated to (2S,3R)-3-methyl-L-glutamate, the 3-MeGlu residue of the lipopeptide A54145. LptI is a homologue of GlmT and DptI from other pathways that catalyze the same C-3 methylation reaction.

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 fixed general comment, added MIBiG crossref.

reactions.description: C-methylation of C-3 of 2-oxoglutarate to give (3R)-3-methyl-2-oxoglutarate
the product is transaminated to (2S,3R)-3-methyl-L-glutamate and incorporated into A54145 by LptD
